findings.problem: all four agent users get the same password DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD; email login is on the agent ingress; with it I logged in as reader@t-beta and minted a 365-day t-beta API token (201), which revoking the agent's known token does not stop
findings.required_improvement: per-agent random password that is not stored (or password login disabled for agent users); stand test: login of an agent email with DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD fails

findings.problem: the stand bundle is built once; 24 h later demo /readyz is 503, compose up --wait and restart fail; rerun of stand/run.sh the next day fails
findings.required_improvement: rebuild (re-sign with new built_at) the bundle on every init.py / run.sh run; drop the runbook row

findings.problem: the 'stale bundle' case is rejected as rollback (demo log 'older than a bundle loaded before (rollback)'), so it passes without the 24 h check
findings.required_improvement: clear /var/lib/demo/bundle-state.json before the stale case, assert the not_ready reason 'older than 24 h', restore afterwards

findings.problem: SSE call path (/sse, /servers/{id}/sse + /message) is live (allowed calls reach demo) but untested; the GO claims deny on every path; denied SSE calls return result {} instead of an error
findings.required_improvement: add SSE paths to Stand.paths() (mcp.client.sse.sse_client) and run SC-01 deny/other-team and SC-03 over them; record the empty-result behaviour in the GO note

findings.problem: audit keeps only outcome=unauthenticated; a JWS with an unknown kid is indistinguishable from a missing header, so no alert is possible
findings.required_improvement: log TokenError.reason in the audit entry; assert reason 'kid' for the unknown-kid case in test_sc04

findings.problem: timeout after the backend got the request returns temporarily_unavailable, defined in MCC-05 as 'запрос не выполнен'
findings.required_improvement: spec note in MCC-05 for read tools (or another code); no code change needed for read

findings.problem: stand bundle_version is forty zeros, not the git SHA
findings.required_improvement: pass git rev-parse HEAD as --bundle-version and report it

findings.problem: report generated at feb5de0, not at the head; FastMCP version is a literal
